hero.subtitle: Sawtak connects citizens directly with members of parliament — submit your issue, track its resolution, and confirm the outcome. Everything is digital, transparent, and secure.

features.title: Why Sawtak?
features.easy_report_desc: Submit your issue in less than 30 seconds with image upload and instant classification.
features.privacy_desc: Your data is protected with advanced encryption. No public sharing without your permission.
features.analytics_desc: Comprehensive statistics to help MPs make faster and more accurate decisions.
features.realtime_desc: Track your issue status in real-time with instant notifications on every update.
features.coverage_desc: Connecting citizens with MPs across all governorates and constituencies.
features.review_desc: A specialized team reviews and classifies every issue professionally before presenting it.

vision.title: About Us
vision.our_vision_desc: Connecting every Egyptian citizen directly with their representative for genuine and effective communication.
vision.our_mission_desc: Empowering citizens to voice their concerns easily and track the resolution of their issues step by step.
vision.our_values_desc: Transparency, credibility, and protecting citizens' privacy are the foundation of everything we build.
vision.smart_management_desc: The management team classifies issues and routes them to the relevant MP automatically and accurately.

steps.title: How Does Sawtak Work?
steps.step1_desc: Create a free citizen account in seconds
steps.step2_desc: Describe the issue and attach up to 5 photos or files
steps.step3_desc: The management team reviews, classifies, and routes the issue to the relevant MP
steps.step4_desc: Receive instant notifications and confirm the resolution
